##### Project general facts

EVERGR1N House 4 is a contemporary residential development located in Jumeirah Garden City, designed as a modern urban sanctuary that blends architectural elegance with lush green surroundings. Positioned in one of Dubai’s most central and vibrant communities, the project offers residents a refined lifestyle with easy access to key landmarks and major city destinations. The building features a clean, modern façade with expansive glazing and carefully considered design elements that emphasize natural light, openness, and a strong connection to the surrounding landscape. Its architectural concept focuses on combining urban sophistication with a calm, nature-inspired living environment.

The development offers a comprehensive selection of lifestyle amenities designed to support wellness, recreation, and community living. Residents can enjoy a swimming pool with sun deck, a dedicated kids’ pool and playground, a fully equipped gym, a health club, and an outdoor lounge area. Additional facilities include a clubhouse and landscaped leisure spaces that encourage social interaction and relaxation. With two levels of parking and well-planned communal areas, EVERGR1N House 4 ensures convenience and comfort while promoting a balanced and active lifestyle in a green-infused urban setting.

The interiors are finished with high-quality modern materials and incorporate advanced smart home technology throughout the residences. Electrical fittings, sockets, and switches are provided by Legrand, ensuring reliability and modern functionality. Kitchens are fully equipped with appliances by Bertazzoni, including a refrigerator, gas hob, extractor hood, oven, and microwave, while studios also include a washing machine and dishwasher. Plumbing fixtures are supplied by Ramon Soler or Gala. The residences are delivered fully furnished, offering a turnkey living experience that combines functionality, comfort, and contemporary design.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Garden City is a prime area located in the heart of Dubai, known for its strategic positioning and accessibility. Situated close to Sheikh Zayed Road, one of Dubai’s main arterial roads, the area provides residents and businesses with easy access to key parts of the city, including Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and the Dubai International Airport. This location makes it a highly sought-after spot for both residential and commercial developments, catering to professionals, families, and businesses looking for a central and convenient setting.

The area is designed to offer a balanced blend of urban living and natural beauty, featuring a mix of high-rise buildings, mid-rise residential complexes, and villas surrounded by lush landscaping. Jumeirah Garden City is planned to include extensive green spaces, parks, and water features, creating a serene environment amidst the urban landscape. This integration of nature within the city is intended to promote a sense of community and well-being among its residents, offering a peaceful retreat from the hustle and bustle of city life.

In addition to its residential offerings, Jumeirah Garden City host a variety of retail outlets, dining establishments, and entertainment options, making it a self-sufficient neighborhood with everything residents need within easy reach. The development aims to enhance the quality of life for its inhabitants by providing modern amenities, recreational facilities, and community spaces that encourage social interaction and a healthy lifestyle. Its commitment to combining luxury living with environmental sustainability and urban convenience makes Jumeirah Garden City a unique and desirable destination in Dubai.
